instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a small exposed supply-air duct run serving two terminals in a compact plantroom mock-up. The mechanical contractor needs the air-side network to behave as one verified supply system rather than disconnected products. Preserve the existing duct segment, fitting, and terminal geometry, but organise them under a single supply-air system, add the missing connection ports, and make the port-to-port relationships complete enough for downstream commissioning checks. Stamp the system and assigned products with revision code BONSAI-CLI-07.
